messages:
Maya - Content: quick microcopy sprint \/ need testable variants for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing pages + 2 social captions + webinar CTA + exact inbound routing. Ship to staging by 5pm PT. Keep things short and A/B-friendly.

Ethan (Growth): Ill handle the socials and scheduling. Plan: announce + reminder 48h. Test messaging: "Lower unit cost" vs "Predictable latency". Ill add UTM templates.

Zoe - PMM: Ill do subheads and webinar bullets. Focus on outcomes: ship time, cost predictability, and compliance. No hard numbers in copy.

Rafael (Ops): routing rules: detect company_email and compliance flag. If company_size>250 or enterprise_keyword present -> enterprise queue with high priority. Add utm_campaign & event_id. Draft mapping below.

```
form_type -> queue (conditions)
contact:demo -> sales-enterprise (company_email OR company_size>250)
signup:trial -> growth-trials (company_email)
signup:self-serve -> onboarding-freemium (personal_email)
question:compliance -> solutions-eng (compliance:true)
support:incident -> eng-oncall (severity:high)
```

Maya - Content: hero lines (pick one per mode, keep <8 words):
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features fast. No infra."
- Hosted (alt): "Instant API for production LLMs."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPUs, predictable throughput."
- Dedicated (alt): "Committed capacity, consistent SLAs."
- Private: "Inference inside your network."
- Private (alt): "VPC & on-prem for regulated apps."

Zoe - PMM: subheads (one sentence each):
- Hosted: "Turn prototypes into features with predictable latency."
- Dedicated: "Committed capacity for steady high-throughput workloads."
- Private: "Control data residency and access for regulated needs."

Zoe - PMM: webinar headline + bullets:
Headline: "Deploying LLMs: Benchmarks, Choices, and Runbooks"
Bullets:
- "What to track: median latency, tail spikes, and cost/unit"
- "How to decide: hosted vs dedicated vs private for your product"
- "Operational steps: rollouts, fallbacks, and monitoring recipes"

Ethan (Growth): social captions (2 drafts):
- Post A (cost angle): "Lower inference unit cost without sacrificing quality. See Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployment patterns. Webinar + demo -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=post"
- Post B (reliability angle): "Keep LLM features reliable at scale. Predictable latency, transparent controls, private deployment options. RSVP for demo -> [link]?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=post"

Rafael (Ops): ops notes: add form fields: company_email, company_size, compliance_checkbox, utm_campaign, event_id. If company_size>250 or compliance_checkbox=true then set priority=high and route to sales-enterprise. Tag webinar signups with event_id and utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch.

DeployBot: Reminder 1 content push to staging scheduled at 17:30 PT. Will deploy when files appear in /marketing/staging.

Maya - Content: assigning: Ethan finalize social posts + UTMs; Zoe tighten webinar bullets and subheads; Rafael implement routing rules and confirm queue names; Ill compile landing copy and upload to staging for review. Quick signoff at 16:45 PT. :white_check_mark:
